summary: Tested the new Admin Compliance feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_compliance.py (37 tests, 36 pass) covering audit-log search (RBAC 403 for driver/facility, q free-text on actor email/name + action/entity/entity_id, q+action combined, entity/action filters, inclusive date_from/date_to, future range empty, actor_name/actor_email enrichment, no _id leak), view logging + 10-min dedupe, missing-POD (delivered-without-event flagged as no_delivered_event with facility/driver enrichment; job with delivered event + evidence_url correctly excluded), credential alerts (insurance_expired -> insurance_expiring -> cleared, driver1 restored), retention (defaults, 422 for 20/0/-5/4000, update audited with {from,to}, purge audited with admin actor + last_purge wiring) and a REAL redaction proof (facility-portal job delivered with recipient PII + signature evidence, created_at backdated to 400 days in Mongo -> purge set recipient_name/phone='[REDACTED]', data_purged=true, purged_at set, custody-event recipient_name redacted and evidence_url nulled, while a fresh job kept its PII/evidence), custody PDF (admin+dispatcher 200 %PDF attachment via ?auth= and Bearer, driver/facility 403, bogus job 404, bad token 401, export audited), breach report (admin-only, 422 on missing/bad dates, summary internally consistent with records, created_at range respected, CSV headers/row-count match JSON, export audited, empty range 0), plus regression on dispatch board and all admin endpoints. FIXED an in-scope async bug that made the whole q search return 500. Frontend: Compliance tab renders all 20 testids, stat cards (0 missing-POD / 0 alerts / 365d + last-purge line), audit search by 'dispatcher1' (100 rows, 0 mismatches), action=purge filter (11 rows, all purge badges), date filter (all rows on the selected day), seeded missing-POD job appeared as a red-tinted row with export button, retention 20 -> inline 422 toast 'Input should be greater than or equal to 30', 180 saved + display -> 180d, restored to 365, 'Run purge now' -> toast 'Purge complete - 0 job(s) redacted' and new purge row visible after re-search, custody PDF + breach CSV both open download popups, breach compile -> summary '8 affected jobs / 1 with personal data / 1 recipients / 1 drivers / 2 facilities'. Regression: Revenue/Drivers/Facilities/Jobs/Ledger tabs, dispatch board, driver dashboard all load with zero console errors.

critical.issue: DUPLICATE, UN-DEDUPED VIEW AUDIT: server.py line ~2224 still has a leftover unconditional `await log_audit(current_user, "view", "job", job_id)` in addition to `log_view_once(...)` at line 2215. Every single GET writes a second 'view' row, defeating the 10-minute dedupe requirement. DB evidence: db.audit_logs has 959 'view' rows, 31 duplicated (actor,job) groups, one pair repeated 485 times (dashboard/board polling). Remove line 2224. Repro: dispatcher GET /api/jobs/{id} once -> GET /api/audit-logs?entity=job&entity_id={id}&action=view returns 2 rows (test_admin_compliance.py::TestViewLogging::test_job_view_logged_and_deduped).

minor.issue: WAS 500 (fixed by testing agent): `[u['id'] async for u in db.users.find(...).to_list(200)]` -> TypeError "'async for' requires an object with __aiter__". The entire free-text search path was broken (main agent's claim that q was self-tested is not reproducible). Fixed to `await ...to_list(200)` then a sync comprehension. Please keep this pattern; there is no other `async for ... .to_list()` left in server.py.
log_view_once is called BEFORE the facility/driver authorization check, so a 403-rejected access is recorded as a successful 'view'. Move the view log after the RBAC block.

The daily loop runs immediately on every startup and always writes a 'purge' audit row even when purged_jobs=0. With hot reload/restarts this spams the audit log (6 system purge rows within ~40s during this session). Suggest only auditing when purged_jobs > 0, or throttling by last_purge timestamp.
JWT passed as ?auth= query param (leaks into browser history/proxy logs) — same pattern already flagged for billing export in iteration 18; consider a short-lived one-time download token.
q builds query['$or'] directly; if a future filter also needs $or it will be silently overwritten. Use $and composition.
Loads all delivered jobs (to_list(10000/20000)) and joins in Python; will not scale and silently truncates. Also missing-pod has no date window filter.

PRE-EXISTING (playbook check): no brute-force lockout — 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 and the valid password still logs in (tests/test_auth_hardening.py::test_brute_force_lockout_after_5_failures fails). Also CORS_ORIGINS="*" with allow_credentials=True (browsers reject credentialed wildcard requests) and no httpOnly cookie is set (token-in-localStorage design). bcrypt $2b$ format check passes.

ui_bugs.issue: No loading/skeleton state: the 3 stat cards render '0 / 0 / —d' and tables show their green 'All delivered jobs have proof-of-delivery.' empty state while the 4 requests are still in flight, which reads as a false all-clear for ~1s.
Uses native <input type="date"> browser pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the app's shadcn calendar — inconsistent with the rest of the design system (same as the Revenue month input).
Copy not pluralization-aware: '1 recipients · 1 drivers · 2 facilities'.

issues: Layout, spacing, contrast and row tints (red missing-POD / amber credential alerts) all correct at 1920x1080; no overlay or clickability problems; toasts fire for every action including validation errors.

action_items: Delete the duplicate `await log_audit(current_user, "view", "job", job_id)` at server.py ~line 2224 (kills the dedupe feature and floods audit_logs) and move log_view_once after the RBAC checks. Consider purging the existing duplicate 'view' rows.
Keep the q-search async fix (server.py ~2568) — it was a hard 500 on every free-text audit search.
Skip the purge audit row (or throttle the startup run) when purged_jobs == 0 to stop restart-time audit spam.
Add loading states to AdminComplianceTab so the compliance cards/tables don't show a premature all-clear.
Optional/pre-existing: brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login, explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of "*" with allow_credentials=True, and paginate/index the missing-pod & breach-report scans.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 2215 + 2224: two view-audit writes in one handler — the second is un-deduped and unconditional; this is the root cause of the dedupe test failure.
server.py 2568 (fixed): `async for` over a `.to_list()` coroutine; add a lint rule/grep for this pattern.
server.py is now 3747 lines — the compliance/billing/admin blocks should be split into routers (repeat of iteration 18 comment).
custody_record_pdf and compliance_breach_report duplicate the same ~12-line ?auth= JWT-decode block; extract a `resolve_download_user()` dependency.

Restored: driver1 insurance_expiry=null + verification_status=approved, retention_days=365, missing-pod count back to 0, credential alerts 0. NOTE: two pre-existing 'TEST_QA Transport' jobs (created 12:00, ids f7b5e255..., ea0e19ca...) from earlier curl testing are still in the DB and appear in the driver's Available Jobs list.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_compliance.py (37 tests; session fixtures auto-delete created jobs, restore driver1 credentials and retention_days=365; uses pymongo via backend/.env MONGO_URL/DB_NAME to backdate created_at for the purge test and to clean ledger rows). The single expected failure is TestViewLogging::test_job_view_logged_and_deduped — it must pass once the duplicate log_audit at server.py ~2224 is removed. POST /api/jobs does NOT persist recipient_name/phone (not in JobCreate); use POST /api/facility/requests to create jobs carrying recipient PII. To create a missing-POD job: dispatcher PUT /api/jobs/{id} accepted(with assigned_driver_id)->picked_up->in_transit->delivered (no custody events required). Frontend login stores the token via AuthContext (not readable at localStorage key 'access_token' in a fresh tab) — use API calls with page.request for seeding/cleanup.
rca_of_the_issue: Two defects found. (1) audit q-search 500: `[u['id'] async for u in db.users.find(...).to_list(200)]` mixes async iteration with .to_list(), which returns a Future — fixed by awaiting to_list then a sync comprehension. (2) View-log dedupe not effective: get_job_by_id calls log_view_once (deduped) at line 2215 and then a leftover unconditional log_audit 'view' at line 2224, so every GET still writes a row; DB shows one actor/job pair with 485 view rows, confirming audit-log growth from polling. Everything else (missing-POD detection, credential alerts, retention validation/purge redaction of jobs + custody events, PDF export, breach report + CSV, and all audit wiring) behaved exactly as specified.
